evaluatorEntrypoints.fmt: cargo fmt --all --check && echo fmt: all files formatted

skill-eval.cmd: cd tools && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s skill-eval -p 'test_*.py' 2>&1 | tail -8

extraDisciplines: contracts-are-pins: contracts/deepsec.json and contracts/agentic-qe.json record upstream release identity (package integrity, supported versions, protocol); they are never edited to make a test pass, and a bump of a pinned upstream version is a HANDOFF needing an ADR and host activation

agentbox-handoff: agentbox owns baking the skill into /opt/agentbox/skills, the pinned release binary and the image rebuild; a change to the skill's file layout, entrypoint name or references/ paths names agentbox as affected and is a HANDOFF
upstream-handoff: behaviour owned by deepsec (vercel-labs), Agentic QE, sealmap/sealmap-corpus and SkillOpt is fixed upstream, not here; VisionCraft only adapts and bounds their observations

skill-prose-is-unmeasured: no night evaluator reads skills/visioncraft/** (cargo tests do not include it and skill-eval covers only tools/skill-eval); a change confined to skill prose has no evidence here and must be stated as INCONCLUSIVE, not ACCEPT

unmirrored-ci-gates: the nightly evaluators do not run `cargo package`, the MSRV 1.88 check or `sealmap generate --check`; a public-API change that could alter docs/diagrams/generated or the packaged crate is a HANDOFF naming those CI jobs
